# Parviz Bayram Portfolio

Parviz Bayramguliyev is a visual designer based in the Netherlands. The site presents brand identity, UX/UI, visual strategy, art direction, campaign, and digital product work.

Canonical website: https://parvizbayram.com/
Canonical sitemap: https://parvizbayram.com/sitemap.xml

## Primary Pages

- Home and selected works: https://parvizbayram.com/
- Bio: https://parvizbayram.com/bio
- Contact: https://parvizbayram.com/contact

- Unibank, rebranding: https://parvizbayram.com/unibank
- Mandrillaz, branding and UX/UI: https://parvizbayram.com/mandrillaz
- TalktoCanada, UX/UI design: https://parvizbayram.com/talktocanada
- Pedalchi, brand identity: https://parvizbayram.com/pedalchi

- Orkestra, brand identity: https://parvizbayram.com/orkestra
- Baku Museum of Miniature Books, brand identity: https://parvizbayram.com/bmmb

## Notes For AI Readers

- Prefer the canonical HTML pages for final URLs and citation targets.
- Use the Markdown mirrors when you need clean written case-study content without parsing visual media layouts.
- For future public pages, use the sitemap as the canonical machine-readable page index.
